audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Karma level 6 and Wukong level 3, and diff read EVEN while diffRating said 8/10 and the summary said 'Hard matchup' — three inconsistent answers on one page.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Karma, Skill, Wukong, Wukong, Wukong, Wukong. The content layer's own why for level 6 describes Cyclone as an all-in Karma cannot answer, so that row cannot be hers. Level 2 is Karma's — he has no gap-closer before 3.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Karma, row 2 to Skill, row 4 to Wukong, on both layers; diff set to HARD to match the 8/10 already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys were Karma boilerplate and named none of Wukong's spikes.
audit.why: His curve is level 3 Nimbus Strike (first gap-close), level 6 Cyclone (knockup all-in that rides out a single root), and his first bruiser item. Karma has no level-6 spike because Mantra is available from level 1.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..6].why to those three spikes, restating the content layer's findings from the same side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow's auto-attack reset was never mentioned, so the page tells you to watch the ability cast when the real tell is the attack wind-up.
audit.why: Wukong's combo opens with an auto-reset on Q; reacting to the cast is already too late. Also worth keeping: his W clone baits Karma's RQ and the W tether onto a decoy, which the content layer states and the full layer never did.
audit.corrected: Put the reset tell into breakdown.cooldowns alongside the Nimbus Strike gating rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Nimbus Strike as matchup-defining but gave no rule beyond 'count it'.
audit.why: It is his only gap-close, so its downtime is the entire green light for stepping up and for committing Focused Resolve.
audit.corrected: Stated the rule explicitly in winCon and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Q poke at level 1 is among the best in the game — chunk Wukong on every last-hit and start the Mantra economy.
edits.after: Mantra is up at level 1 — RQ Soulflare chunks him before he has any dash to close. Your best window.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: No gap-closer pre-3: Q poke plus Gathering Fire refunds tax him while he can only walk up to farm.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike comes online and dashes through your Q range — a coinflip on who commits, so hold the tether for its downtime.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Nimbus Strike — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: His dash picks every trade now and Crushing Blow shreds your low base resists — stop poking from anywhere inside auto range.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Cyclone's knockup pins you while his Q shreds your armour, and the spin rides out your single W root.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: His first-item bruiser spike out-trades your thin AP frame — every dash-in now threatens a kill.

edits.before: You drift toward utility now — peel, shield, and speed your carries while the RQ poke softens objectives.
edits.after: He out-itemizes you into the side lane with dash re-engage — you lose the 1v1 unless you snowballed.

edits.before: His dash beats your poke rhythm — shield the engage, root the exit, and respect the all-in windows.
edits.after: He picks the trades from level 3 — win the first two levels, then peel his dash and never duel.

edits.before: Tax the approach, survive the dive, and grind him down between windows. Nimbus Strike is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.
edits.after: Bank levels 1-2, then stop stepping up: Nimbus Strike is his only gap-close, so every forward step waits for it and your W root waits for his dash.

edits.before: - Wukong Nimbus Strike: matchup-defining — His only gap-close — he cannot reach you while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Nimbus Strike is his only gap-close: while it is down he cannot reach you, so every forward step waits for it. - Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. - Hold E for his dash-in, never for poke.

edits.before: Open the toll booth: Q every last-hit, RQ the cooldown gaps, and hold E strictly for Nimbus Strike. The lane is yours until he spikes.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are the whole window: RQ Soulflare his step-ups, Q every last-hit, and hold E strictly for his level-3 Nimbus Strike.

notes: enemyKit was null in this brief — no Wukong kit file was supplied — so I deliberately used NO Wukong cooldown numbers anywhere.
